Are there any anime characters you like despite having Mary Sue traits?

Sure, a few. If it's done well it's not necessarily a bad thing on its own.

Mary Sue characters tend to be a bother when the story focuses too much on how great they are and focus too much on them, but if they're in an interesting place and have a good enough cast supporting them, then they can work. How others react to them is kind of important too in this regard.

A Mary Sue is very hard to do well, but it can be done and work. The devil is in the details.

Son Goku is absolutely a Mary Sue.

Sakamoto is too, but that's the entire joke. Sakamoto Desu Ka? is a great show, but the entire gag is how everyone reacts to him being an uber Mary Sue.

As an example of a Mary Sue that doesn't work, Kirito from SAO. SAO isn't a bad show per say as the supporting cast kind of mediates his awfulness a bit, but he's really a terrible Mary Sue that doesn't work and drags the show down because of it.
